objective: Give the shipped page an item paste box so a player can evaluate THEIR OWN item. Today web/src/demo/App.tsx offers a two-entry 'Hotkey item' dropdown -- a golden fixture and a deliberate 422 -- and that demo surface is what packaging/launch.py serves as the product (web/src/main.tsx renders this exact App). A tester therefore cannot evaluate a single item they own. (1) Add web/src/components/ItemInput.tsx: a textarea whose value the player pastes in-game Ctrl+C text into, plus one explicit submit control; submitting calls the injected onEvaluate(itemText) exactly once (S2 -- one server action per explicit user action; no evaluate-on-keystroke, no debounce-fired request, no request on an empty or whitespace-only textarea). (2) Wire it into App.tsx as the PRIMARY item path, replacing the picker's role: the page starts with an empty box and NO card and issues NO request until the player submits. Keep the two demo entries only as a clearly-labelled secondary control, or delete them -- your call, but the paste box must be what a first-time player reaches first. (3) A Ctrl+V (paste event) anywhere on the page that is not already inside a text field routes the pasted text into the box and submits it, so the pre-overlay flow is one keypress (issue #90 AC-3). (4) Update the harness note text so it describes pasting your own item, not picking a fixture. Doctrine: I1 -- a paste box is an input surface, not a settings surface; add no options, no preset selector, no advanced panel. I5 -- unreadable text must reach the server and render whatever honest answer it returns; never pre-judge item text in the client.
constraints: The card, session machine, and generated client are untouched: the paste box feeds the SAME useCardSession evaluate() the picker feeds today. Do not fork the session logic.
Exactly one POST /diff per explicit submit (S2). No keystroke-triggered, no retry, no polling.
No settings surface (I1): no preset picker, no toggles, no persisted preferences on this page.
Existing tests may be EXTENDED, never deleted or skipped -- a removed assertion fails completion proof 7 at the merge robot.
The two existing web/test files in scope change only where the picker they drive was replaced; if a test needs no change, leave it byte-identical.
Stage PR uses 'Refs #90', never 'Fixes' (ADR-0008): #90's zip/release/announcement criteria are a later stage.

acceptance_criteria.text: A player can paste arbitrary in-game Ctrl+C item text into a textarea on the shipped page and submit it; the rendered card is the real server's answer for that exact text.
web/test/ItemInput.test.tsx proves: submitting calls onEvaluate exactly once with the exact pasted text; an empty or whitespace-only box issues NO call; typing without submitting issues NO call.
A paste event outside any text field routes the text into the box and submits it exactly once (tested).
On first render the page shows no verdict card and has issued no /diff request; the card appears only after a submit.
The real-server e2e (web/test/realServer.e2e.test.tsx) drives the item through the PASTE BOX rather than the picker, so the proven path is the player's path.
npm --prefix web run test:ui and npm --prefix web run build both pass; no test was deleted or skipped.

rollback: git revert the stage commit; the page returns to the two-entry demo picker with no other behavior changed.
